description: One test's result, set by itself (no bundling): {script, suite, test, verified, severity}, severity from 0.0 to 1.0. A script with no row, or changed since its row, gets its script and suite rows first, as a change makes them. The same result as the test's current row moves its tested, its two hashes (judged, the script's, and suiteHash, the suite's) and its severity only upward; a flipped result makes a new current row and keeps the old one as history, its severity the higher of the two. The two hashes are the ones the runner took when it started that suite for that script; a result from no run of it gets the script and suite rows' hashes as they stand. A suite row with no row for this script is made, flagged. Answers the test's current row. A name that is no production script answers "not a production script"; a script neither there nor known, "no such file".
